original_question: Write a Verilog module named `mux17`. It should have inputs `input [16:0] A`, `input [16:0] B`, and `input S`, and an output `output [16:0] MO`. The module should implement a 2-to-1 multiplexer where the output `MO` takes the value of input `B` when the select input `S` is logic 1, and takes the value of input `A` when the select input `S` is logic 0.
